precast.where: light beige-grey exposed-aggregate precast strips around windows and spandrels (shaded #918878-#948d82 in sv_W0/sv_W4; brightness judged against sunlit W0 parapet #a29281 and Earth); guess on exact value

door_canopy.where: flat dark-grey metal canopy over the W0 doors

banners.where: two tall black banners/sign panels on W2 (Earth reads them navy #273e59 because of its blue cast)

geometry_notes: W3 (SE, 74.6 m) is a party wall with STC W0 for s 7.4-74.6 (STC W0 runs 883.7,171.7 -> 942.9,202.0, coincident within 0.5 m). Only s 0-7.4 is open, in the re-entrant corner next to STC's stone stair tower (STC W1), and it is roofed over by the W2 concrete canopy at ground level.
W4 (NE, 22.8 m) is a party wall with B1: B1 W1 (929.5,229.0 -> 963.3,162.1) passes through both W4 ends within 0.5 m. B1's blank brick SW wall then continues ~8 m north past W0 (seen left in sv_W0).

W0 is the recessed entrance bay between B1's projecting brick end and the QNC bridge; its 1.9 m jog to W1 (W0.b 925.3,218.8 vs W1.a 924.0,220.7) is real: the vestibule under the bridge sits ~2 m further out than the entrance doors (sv_W0, sv_c4).

Roof is two levels: a lower strip ~7 m deep along W1 at ~12.8-13 m (lidar 12-13.5) and the central/SE body at ~14 m (lidar 13.5-15), with a parapet step line visible parallel to W1 (orbit_090). The lidar 14.2 m building height is the upper body; the W1 and W2 parapets read about 13 m.
Ground falls slightly toward W2 / Ring Road; no level change modelled.

W0.summary: recessed main north entrance off the QNC lane: two precast bays of four tall white-framed windows per floor between buff brick piers; double glazed doors with sidelights under a flat dark metal canopy in the west bay
attached: door canopy 3.3 m wide x 1.0 m deep at 2.7-2.9 m over the double doors (sv_W4_Hlv)
QNC bridge lands just west of this wall (see W1)
W0.notes: Counted from sv_W0_DPVv_100 and sv_W4_Hlv_100 (Sep 2014). Ground windows: 4 lights each split by a transom at ~2.0 m, with a precast sill panel below; doors are a pair of glazed aluminium doors plus a glazed sidelight each side, transom glass above to ~3.0 m. Spandrels between floors are precast with a thin projecting ledge. Upper windows: 4 tall lights per bay (each ~0.7 m wide) with a small top transom. Piers are brick full height.

W1.summary: long north wall along the 7-8 m lane to QNC: buff brick with vertical precast strips holding one white-framed window per floor, strips paired (thin brick pilaster between) and pairs separated by wide brick piers; glazed vestibule under the QNC bridge at the east end, louvre at ground just west of it
attached: QNC glazed bridge (levels 2-3) lands on s 0-5.5; underside ~4.3 m, dark slatted soffit, one V-shaped pair of silver steel struts at s ~4, 3 m out (sv_c4/c5_Hlv). Drawn from QNC's site.bridges.
vestibule screen under the bridge, s 0-3.4: 4 glazed leaves with warm wood-lined interior visible (sv_c4)
W1.notes: Only the two ends are photographed close: east end sv_c4/c5_Hlv (2014), west end sv_W1_PgZG (2014, back-lit) and earth_detail_2a (2024, upper two floors over the QNC green roof). Both ends show the same system: precast strips ~1.8 m wide with one ~1.15 x 1.7 m two-light window per floor, brick between. The 8-module rhythm (pair of strips + ~3 m brick pier) is fitted to the length and to the Earth view (which shows pairs separated by wide brick and at least one wider ~4 m blank brick stretch near mid-length, and a precast strip with 4 narrow lights near the west third - not placed, uncertain). West corner pier ~2.6 m blank brick (sv_W1_PgZG). Ground-floor windows sit slightly lower and taller.

W2.summary: west end toward Ring Road: almost blank buff brick with a narrow recessed precast stair slot of small windows and two tall black sign banners on the south part; a flat concrete canopy (2024, not in 2014) runs along the base of the south two-thirds into the STC corner

signs.text: left banner: white crest/logo near the top and two lines of small white text lower down (illegible in Earth); guess: Faculty of Science / Biology
right banner: three short lines of white text at the top and one lower (illegible)

attached: flat concrete canopy/overhang (light grey, ~0.6 m fascia) at about 3.0-3.6 m, ~2.5 m deep, from s ~10 to the wall end and on into the corner with STC (earth_facade_1, earth_corner_0/1, 2024). Dark shaded zone beneath. Absent in sv_c0 (2014), so built with STC (~2016). Height and depth are estimates.
W2.notes: Wall extent and slot from earth_facade_1 (830 px = 25.5 m; slot at s 11.7-13.1, banners at s 16.5-19.4 and 20.4-23.3). Banners measured ~2.9 m wide and roughly z 4-11 (vertical scale less certain); modelled as the two upper rows of the banner bays. sv_c0 (2014) shows the slot as a precast strip with small windows on each floor and the roof slightly higher north of the slot (parapet step, ~0.5 m, uncertain). The low ground area along W2 in 2014 held a fenced transformer/electrical box.

W3.summary: party wall with STC for s 7.4-74.6; only a 7.4 m stub of plain brick in the re-entrant corner next to STC's stair tower, under the W2 canopy
W3.notes: No photo shows the stub square-on (sv_W3_CIHM is black). STC (~22 m) stands against the rest; B2's wall is not visible above it.

W4.notes: B1 W1 coincides with this wall within 0.5 m (walls.json of both).
